strategy_roster.name: Puria Method
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,10) > ema(close,20) and ema(close,20) > ema(close,40) and crossabove(macd(close,12,26),macd_signal(close,12,26,9))
strategy_roster.notes: Three moving averages in rising order plus a MACD(12/26/9) momentum cross implement the documented momentum-breakout filter. Ma0/1/2 periods are names only, so 10/20/40 are fallbacks, and the pip stop/target/trailing, MacdTrendBars monotonic check and partial profit taking are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Z-Score RSI
strategy_roster.notes: All three documented lengths are used literally: the price z-score over ZScoreLength=20, its RSI(9) and the EMA(15) smoothing, with the long on the RSI-over-EMA cross and the opposite cross as exit. The docs list no stops, so both percentage fields are null.

strategy_roster.name: Stop Loss Take Profit
strategy_roster.notes: Entries come from a pseudo-random coin flip whenever the account is flat, with martingale doubling after a stop, so there is no deterministic signal to mine. The never-true guard is used; StopLossPips/TakeProfitPips of 1 are pip offsets, not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Stochastic Momentum Filter
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,6) > ema(close,85) and rsi(close,5) < 30 and rsi(close,21) < 30 and roc(close,14) > 0.3
strategy_roster.exit_long: ema(close,6) < ema(close,85) or rsi(close,5) > 80 or rsi(close,21) > 80
strategy_roster.notes: Documented FastMaPeriod=6 / SlowMaPeriod=85, the 5/2/2 and 21/4/10 oscillators mapped to RSI(5)/RSI(21), StochasticBuyLevel 30 / SellLevel 80, MomentumPeriod 14 and MomentumThreshold 0.3 are all retained. The higher-timeframe MACD filter, MT4 momentum baseline of 100 and point stops (20/50) cannot be represented on a single series.

strategy_roster.name: Fisher Cyber Cycle
strategy_roster.notes: The Fisher Transform of the Cyber Cycle is approximated by a bounded oscillator (RSI with Length=8) versus a 7-bar EMA trigger, giving the documented Fisher-over-trigger cross and its opposite as exit. Alpha=0.07 has no counterpart in the whitelisted indicators, and the docs state no stops.

strategy_roster.name: MACD Divergence
strategy_roster.notes: FastMacdPeriod 12, SlowMacdPeriod 26 and SignalPeriod 9 are documented, and the DivergencePeriod=5 window is used for the price-versus-MACD divergence leg. StopLossPercent=2.0m is retained; no take-profit value is documented.

strategy_roster.name: Exp Extremum
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc((high - donchian_low(high,14)) + (low - donchian_high(low,14)),1) < 0 and roc((high - donchian_low(high,14)) + (low - donchian_high(low,14)),2) > 0
strategy_roster.exit_long: roc((high - donchian_low(high,14)) + (low - donchian_high(low,14)),1) > 0 and roc((high - donchian_low(high,14)) + (low - donchian_high(low,14)),2) < 0
strategy_roster.notes: The documented pressure sum (current high minus lowest high, plus current low minus highest low over Length bars) is written with donchian_low(high) and donchian_high(low); its up-then-down sign flip opens the long. Length has no documented value, so 14 is a fallback, and the BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen permission flags are not encoded.

strategy_roster.name: Pure Price Action
strategy_roster.notes: Length=5 is used, with the long break of structure as a close above the prior 5-bar high and the mirrored break as exit. SlPercent=1m and TpPercent=2m are the documented fixed percentage stop and target.

strategy_roster.name: Tian Di Grid Merge
strategy_roster.notes: Orders are placed at arithmetic or geometric levels between user-defined upper and lower bounds and merged when profit exceeds a grid step, i.e. a multi-order grid engine with no market-derived entry signal. The never-true guard is used.

strategy_roster.name: Stochastic Three Periods
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(rsi(close,5),ema(rsi(close,5),3)) and roc(close,3) > 0 and rsi(close,14) > 50 and rsi(close,30) > 50
strategy_roster.notes: KPeriod1=5 with the 3-bar ShiftEntrance and the 15m/30m confirmations are approximated by RSI(5) versus EMA(3), a 3-bar price move and the 14/30-bar oscillators all on the positive side. The exit is the documented opposite fast cross, and TakeProfitPoints=30 / StopLossPoints=10 are point offsets, not percentages.
